claims.statement: A Thai bank account is not required to apply for a DTV or to complete the 180-day in-country extension; foreign personal bank accounts holding 500,000 THB equivalent are accepted.
Thai banks treat the DTV under tourist-class rules and routinely refuse walk-in DTV account openings under tightened anti-mule-account compliance.
Long-term resident visas such as the BOI LTR include formal bank account opening assistance.
